claim.quote: we derive values for the electron recoil statistical rejection power of more than 10$^8$ in the tonne-scale liquid argon target for events with more than 50 detected photons at a 50% acceptance for nuclear recoils.

key_value_text.quote: electron recoil statistical rejection power of more than 10$^8$
key_value_text.value: electron recoil statistical rejection power of more than 10$^8$

name: Backgrounds and pulse shape discrimination in the ArDM liquid argon TPC

summary.plain: From the 2015 single-phase run ArDM showed that pulse shape alone can reject electron-recoil backgrounds by better than one part in 100 million in a tonne of liquid argon, and measured its backgrounds.
summary.technical: Pulse-shape discrimination estimated from a Cf-252 neutron calibration (Gaussian electron- and nuclear-recoil bands); the abstract also gives the Rn-222 emanation rate of the cryostat (65.6+-0.4 microHz/l), the 39Ar activity of the atmospheric argon (0.95+-0.05 Bq/kg) and the cosmic muon flux at Canfranc.

title: Backgrounds and pulse shape discrimination in the ArDM liquid argon TPC
why_it_matters: The abstract says the results pave the way for the next physics run of ArDM in double-phase mode.
